spec.name: Furniture Birch Dresser
spec.description: A wide, grounded birch dresser with six inset-looking drawer fronts, dark wooden pulls, a substantial overhanging top and four short feet. Front faces negative Z. Bounds are x=0.25..31.75, y=0..16, z=0.25..15.75. All 22 cuboids are connected through intersecting structural volumes, with separated outward surfaces and individually allocated cube nets.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: wide birch dresser with six drawers and dark handles. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
